_doc: ARC §1.4 UI on the §6.7 stub: chip glyphs (region view), the Hearts layer, the settlement inspector's Hearts section. 888x500 with UI. Run: setsid nohup _harness/slot.sh node _harness/shots.mjs _harness/arc-work/specs/ui-hearts.json --port=5311 > _harness/scratch/arc/shots-hearts.log 2>&1 &

shots.name: arc-hearts-chips
script: const H = (kind, o) => Object.assign({ kind, proud: false, devoted: 0.1, fearful: 0.1, restless: 0.1, defiant: 0, pride: 0.3, defiance: 0.1, dusk: 0.3, duskYearAgo: 0.6, caption: '', line: '', remember: [], answered: '' }, o);

G.arc.stub('hearts', [{ settlement: ids[0], heart: H('fearful', { fearful: 0.52, proud: true, pride: 0.68, caption: 'They watch the sky', line: 'In this town they watch the sky and speak quietly.', remember: ['the storm that took the harvest'] }) }, { settlement: ids[1], heart: H('defiant', { defiant: 0.41, defiance: 0.55, caption: 'They raise their fists' }), defiant: { kind: 'curse', tick: 1 } }]);
return { ids, st: G.ui_.state().overlay ?? null, chips: document.querySelectorAll('.gn-slabel-heart').length };

shots.name: arc-hearts-inspector
script: await G.frames(20); const s = document.querySelector('.gn-insp-hearts'); if (s) s.scrollIntoView(); await G.frames(4); return { hearts: s?.textContent?.slice(0, 300) ?? null };
